facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Love is powerful. It changes everything. This is the lesson. Love is the lesson.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The story of the velveteen rabbit teaches us about love. Love is the most powerful force in the whole world. Love is the lesson we should always remember. It can turn something ordinary into something magical. The boy's love made a simple toy into a living rabbit. We should love with all our heart every single day.
facts.Word cards: love = 사랑 / makes = 만든다 / magic = 마법 / power = 힘
